- memory_id "1000547": On 2025-07-30, Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000541": As of 2025-07-24, the Dune team sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000488": As of 2025-06-11, the notifier went to the Dune team, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11; the Cinder team never owned the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000480": As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler lives with the Dune team, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000338" [decision]: As of 2025-04-21, the Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000279": As of 2025-03-20, the reporting service is owned by the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000126": The reporting service is a Dune team service.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000097": As of 2025-01-13, the first on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000048": As of 2025-01-09, Farah runs the Dune team solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000356": As of 2025-04-24, feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000318": As of 2025-04-07, the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000326" [constraint]: As of 2025-04-15, the reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000335" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000421": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000222": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry hammered the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
